answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 157531 Country: India Title: Can we greet salam in empty showroom or empty shop? Actually I am in a company where there is Islamic culture. Most of the time when we open the showroom I greet salam but one of my friend told it is not right to greet salam in empty shop. Please let me know what does Islam say in this matter? Question: Can we greet salam in empty showroom or empty shop? Actually I am in a company where there is Islamic culture. Most of the time when we open the showroom I greet salam but one of my friend told it is not right to greet salam in empty shop. Please let me know what does Islam say in this matter? Answer ID: 157531 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 453/385/L=4/1439) You may also greet while entering an empty house or shop, but in the following way: السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين قال فى الشامى: وإن دخل بيتاً ليس فيه أحد يقول: السلام علينا وعلى عباد الله الصالحين، فالملائكة ترد عليه السلام . (شامى: 9/592 ط: زكريا ديوبند) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
